cpu: AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 470 w/ Radeon 890M

measurement.wall: seconds include direct process launch, output capture and wait4 polling (1 ms interval)
measurement.rss: per-process peak in KiB; no memory-reduction claim
measurement.cache: cold clears disk cache before every child; hot is independently seeded then read-only; OS page cache is uncontrolled
measurement.phases: nanoseconds, collected with --cache-stats: dependency builds module identity; query includes admission/key/recipe; read and publish include filesystem, checksums, manifest codecs and locking; decode includes result validation; encode excludes publish; evaluate is inclusive function-body time (nested bodies overlap); resource and restore are separate hit phases
